summary: Western Copper and Gold filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 14, 2026 news release announcing that its Casino copper-gold project in the Yukon was selected for the prospectus of the inaugural Canada Investment Summit in Toronto on September 14-15, 2026, hosted by the Government of Canada with CPP Investments and PSP Investments. No securities are offered, no price, stake, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is stated. The filing is a promotional/marketing update, not a special situation; no transaction mechanics or regulatory clock apply. Watch for any subsequent financing, partnership, or strategic investment in Casino.
